result.title: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
result.summary: Effective test-time personalization requires LLM agents to adapt to query-dependent user preferences from lightweight interaction. We study persona selection with binary comparisons between candidate responses as the online signal. We present ID-TAP, a scalable, IDS-inspired neural dueling-bandit framework for large discrete persona spaces. ID-TAP combines a query-conditioned neural utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer, and transfers comparison evidence across related queries through similarity-weighted warm starts. The neural model shares statistical strength across queries while preserving query-specific scores, and efficient BT updates score hypothetical challengers. Across seven user-conditioned generation benchmarks under reference- and model-based preference simulators, ID-TAP achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated baselines within a fixed ten-round comparison budget. These results support information-directed challenger selection as an effective design for test-time persona adaptation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM 智能体的测试时个性化，将人格选择建模为以成对回答比较为在线信号的 dueling bandit 问题，提出 ID-TAP：用查询条件化的神经效用模型结合轻量 Bradley-Terry 探索器，并通过相似度加权热启动跨查询迁移比较证据。
